items.title: Mobile app for students of the Department of Medical Biophysics
items.markdownBody:
# Mobile app for students of the Department of Medical Biophysics

![Mobile app for students of the Department of Medical Biophysics](images/news/news005_mobile_app_release.jpg)

On **24 June 2026** we published the **MedBioPhys** app. Our students increasingly use medical technologies. We know the first year of study is the hardest (later it only gets harder, but you can get used to it). To help students find their way during classes at our department, we decided to release the MedBioPhys app — we will see how useful it is in the upcoming academic year.

*Updated 24.06.2026 by the Department of Medical Biophysics*

items.title: XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art
items.markdownBody:
# XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art

![XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art](images/news/news004_festival.jpg)

On **14 May 2026**, as part of the XXII Podlasie Festival of Science and Art, staff at the Department of Medical Biophysics introduced medical biophysics topics to first- and second-grade primary school pupils and preschool children. The aim of the sessions was to popularize physics in medicine.

*Updated 18.05.2026 by the Department of Medical Biophysics*

items.title: 40 years since the Chernobyl disaster
items.markdownBody:
# 40 years since the Chernobyl disaster

![40 years since the Chernobyl disaster](images/news/news003_spotify.jpg)

On **26 April 2026**, forty years had passed since the accident at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant. On Polish Radio Białystok, in a programme prepared by editor Ryszard Minko, one of the guests was Dr Jacek Kapała from the Department of Medical Biophysics. Topics included monitoring of radioactive contamination in the air, which was lacking in 1986.

Listen on Spotify:

- [40 years since the Chernobyl nuclear disaster](https://open.spotify.com/episode/41IrwBI9bRfaJJJShweBoK?si=LV757jCuQEm8Iq6FkN6lUg)

*Updated 30.04.2026 by the Department of Medical Biophysics*

items.title: Breath of Chernobyl — report on Polish Radio Białystok
items.markdownBody:
# Breath of Chernobyl — report on Polish Radio Białystok

![Breath of Chernobyl — report on Polish Radio Białystok](images/news/news002_radio_bialystok.jpg)

On **27 April 2026**, Polish Radio Białystok broadcast the report *Breath of Chernobyl* by Dominika Dębska and Joanna Sikora. The report presented memories of the nuclear power plant explosion forty years after the disaster. One of those recalling that period was Dr Jacek Kapała from the Department of Medical Biophysics.

Listen on YouTube:

- [40 years since the Chernobyl explosion: How the trauma of 1986 changed Poland](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5eLsEDAZHSA)

*Updated 28.04.2026 by the Department of Medical Biophysics*
